messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — aiming to cut a tiny patch release today to fix a changelog link + a flaky test. Target version v0.23.1. Cutoff for code & changelog edits 18:00 PT. Can owners ack?
Kevin: ack from infra side. I'll queue the branch bump after QA signoff.
Sarah: Can we confirm which tests are gating? I saw flaky in `integration/kv_cache.*`. I can run focused smoke.
AJ: Security review: quick scan done, no new deps. I left a note in GH PR #452. If anyone adds a dependency, ping me.
Samir: Docs: I'll add the changelog entry with the short blurb. Where do we want the "migration note" if any?
Maya: Samir — no migration needed. Just note: "fixed changelog link, flaky test tolerance". Keep to one sentence.
Samir: Got it. I'll push a tiny docs commit in a sec: `git commit -m "chore(changelog): v0.23.1 entry" && git push`
release-bot: CI: build passed on main — 1c2f9ab. E2E flaky suite still running.
Kevin: After QA passes can someone approve the version bump PR? I can merge if approvals + green CI.
Sarah: QA update: ran the focused suite, 3 runs, all good. Filing a short test report in the PR, attaching screenshots.
AJ: Reviewed GH PR #452 and added comment re: KMS key rotation check (not required now). :white_check_mark:
Maya: OK — plan: 18:00 PT cutoff. If everything green by 17:45 I'll merge bump, tag, and kick release job. @Kevin you'll handle merge?
Kevin: Yes. I'll be online and will run `./scripts/release.sh v0.23.1` after merge.
Samir: Docs published to staging, link: https://staging.docs.redwood.inference/changelog#v0-23-1
Maya: Thanks everyone. If any blockers, drop here or DM. :thumbsup:
